A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith Saber''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[41 ABY]], the Human, along with fellow [[Sith Saber|Saber]] [[Shura (Sith)|Shura]] and [[Unidentified dark-skinned Sith Saber|another Saber]], met [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] when she was summoned before the Tribe's ruling council, the [[Circle of Lords]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. When Khai arrived, the Sabers greeted the Tyro, and Shura showed her to the Circle of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was born on the remote<ref name="Omen" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where he lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Due to his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], he was [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on Kesh thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] previously during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Omen" /> By [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he had attained the rank of [[Sith Saber]] in the Tribe. In that year, a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] called [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] arrived on the world and created a bond with the [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]].<ref name="Omen" />

Khai was then summoned before the Tribe's ruling council, the [[Circle of Lords]], in the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] in the Kesh [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. There, the male Saber awaited Khai alongside two fellow Sabers, [[Shura (Sith)|Shura]] and a [[Unidentified dark-skinned Sith Saber|female Saber]]. When Khai arrived, she was greeted by the three Sabers and taken by Shura to the Circle of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]].<ref name="Omen" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive, the Human male was trained by the Lost Tribe and successfully reached the rank of Sith Saber. The Tyro Khai was unable to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] the three Sabers until she could hear the sound of their [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. During the entire conversation with Khai, the male Saber remained silent.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Saber appeared briefly in the [[2009]] novel [[Fate of the Jedi: Omen|''Omen'']], the second installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Omen" />
